paragraphs: Many hospitals in Ireland are too full. On Tuesday, 777 patients were on trolleys. They had no hospital bed.

The nurses' union counts these patients every day. University Hospital Limerick had the most, with 108. Letterkenny had 62 and St Vincent's in Dublin had 58. In the west and north-west, more than 199 people had no bed.
Phil Ní Sheaghdha leads the union. She says the situation is dangerous. It came after the long bank holiday weekend. She says nurses are very tired and there are not enough staff.
The union wants hospitals to hire more nurses fast. It wants the health service to fill all empty jobs.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭許多醫院太擁擠了。
週二有777名病人躺在推床上。
他們沒有病床。
護理師工會每天統計這些病人。
利默里克大學醫院最多，有108人。
萊特肯尼有62人，都柏林的聖文森醫院有58人。
在西部和西北部，有超過199人沒有病床。
菲爾·妮·希亞是工會的領導人。
她說情況很危險。
這發生在長長的銀行假日週末之後。
她說護理師非常疲累，人手也不夠。
工會希望醫院盡快僱用更多護理師。
它希望衛生服務單位填補所有空缺職位。

paragraphs: Hospitals in Ireland are dangerously overcrowded, the Irish Nurses and Midwives Organisation (INMO) has warned. On Tuesday, 777 patients were waiting on trolleys because there were no beds for them.

University Hospital Limerick was the worst, with 108 people on trolleys. Letterkenny University Hospital had 62 and St Vincent's University Hospital in Dublin had 58. Across hospitals in Galway, Letterkenny, Sligo and Mayo, more than 199 people had no bed.

Phil Ní Sheaghdha, the head of the INMO, said the problem came after the bank holiday weekend. She called it a total failure in planning. She said nurses are working in wards without enough staff and are caring for too many patients.
She blamed a stop on hiring. She said nurse managers are not allowed to fill empty jobs.
The union wants all empty posts filled quickly. It also wants the Health Service Executive (HSE) to make hiring and staff planning its top priority.
